scope: Original bundled BCM70015 ordinary H264 SPS-to-compact-PIB path; no firmware execution or alteration, device access, external client modification, or runtime qualification in this receipt.

existing_source_bridge.existing_proof_scope: Section-qualified complete body hashes, selected original numeric relocations, geometry and publication equations. The existing mapper does not itself define or validate colour packing.

independent_retained_disassembly_check.interpretation: Conditional GNU legacy ARC base-case instruction and delay-slot interpretation; original numeric relocations and metadata declarations are not a vendor ISA or runtime ABI certificate.

sps_producer.address_domain: Original ELF instruction addresses and relative structure offsets, not live host pointers or device-read instructions.
validity_limits: Absent VUI leaves the packed output word zero after the metadata clear.
VUI present without an explicit colour description retains the initialized 2/2/2 tuple. The packed word has no separate colour-description-present indicator.
The parser consumes video_full_range_flag but its returned value has no retained use or store before the next bit read. This producer word does not establish source quantization.
The three explicit fields are stored as bytes; the firmware sequence does not validate their CICP meaning. Consumers must validate each value.

packed_word.low_byte: Zero in the scoped producer: initialized clear, followed by this packed whole-word store. It is not a range flag.
packed_word.core_population: The pinned Core_PopulatePPB body does not rewrite metadata+48. The existing source bridge then copies the complete 228-byte metadata record.

compact_pib_publication.copy_equation: compact_PIB.colour_primaries at byte40 = metadata DWORD at byte48, unchanged
compact_pib_publication.layout_cross_checks: The same compact record receives width+12, height+16, frame_rate+32 and aspect_ratio+36, matching BC_PIC_INFO_BLOCK.
compact_pib_publication.host_copy_path: Flea FORMAT_CHANGE reads compact PIB and preserves its raw colour_primaries DWORD through RX completion into the native format callback. Public field naming/scalar enum alone does not define this packed firmware representation.

bounded_consumer_policy.recognition: Require low byte zero and recognize all three fields atomically; otherwise keep the freshly normalized OUTPUT hint rather than previous source state.
bounded_consumer_policy.reject: Any unsupported, reserved or partial tuple, and any nonzero low byte; no scalar-primary or geometry-based reconstruction of missing matrix/transfer.
bounded_consumer_policy.source_vs_hint: An accepted source tuple overrides CAPTURE primaries, transfer and matrix. OUTPUT remains the caller hint. G_FMT and TRY_FMT remain observational. Apply only to accepted source-format events and reset the source projection from the hint at each such event.
bounded_consumer_policy.range: No source quantization is established by this word. Preserve existing validated caller quantization only as a compatibility hint, otherwise retain DEFAULT; neither is proof of stream range. Do not derive LIM_RANGE/FULL_RANGE from the tuple or low byte.
bounded_consumer_policy.extended_fields: Advertise V4L2_CAP_EXT_PIX_FORMAT when implementing independent extended fields, obey priv=MAGIC semantics, and return initialized applicable fields. Mixed tuples require those independent fields; a scalar colorspace cannot express the full tuple.
bounded_consumer_policy.client_limit: Correct V4L2 reporting does not establish that every unchanged client consumes mixed tuples correctly. No Kodi/FFmpeg change or full-range qualification is part of this receipt.

primary_contract_sources.supports: CAPTURE colour fields are driver reported; extended-field capability and priv rules.
Independent colour components; DEFAULT quantization means a colorspace default, not an unknown-range marker.

limitations: This is an interpretation of the exact original bundled image and ordinary H264 path, not a vendor packing specification or a guarantee for other firmware, codecs, silicon, CFP2/MVC paths or all firmware consumers.
Original addresses, symbol tables, relocations, instruction bytes and declared extensions are distinct from proof of runtime relocation, vendor ISA semantics or device execution.
No producer full-range, video-signal-present or colour-description-present bit is supplied by the packed word. Unknown, partial and unsupported metadata remains unqualified.
This receipt does not prove detection of all intra-stream colour-only changes. Applying a supplied FORMAT_CHANGE event and proving that firmware emits every required event are separate questions.

No GPU/pixel, physical presentation, performance, native lifetime or heap outcome is claimed. Future one-field controls are experiments to test this interpretation, not a substitute for the producer evidence.
